summary: Asked where someone usually is at a time, Nora now answers from their routine the way a friend who knows it would, instead of opening with «I can't answer» and reciting percentages.
details: The routine arrives already worked out (for example «Mondays 17:00-23:00: almost always at Miles Home»), with how often and any other usual places; the percentages and weeks are kept as evidence for when someone asks how sure she is.
Thin or patchy evidence is said inside that line («roughly», «on a patchy record») rather than as a separate disclaimer.
